description: Audience: all_students_faculty_and_staff. Tool access is separate from assessment permission. Sensitive-data approval: unknown.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: From 31 August 2026, all NUS students, faculty and staff will have access to ChatGPT Edu by OpenAI, further strengthening NUS’ growing portfolio of AI platforms and services. Unlike the free ChatGPT, it provides NUS with broader access to core capabilities within a secure, university-managed environment with stronger privacy, security and administrative controls. Conversations and data within the NUS workspace are not used to train OpenAI’s models.

description: Audience: staff_departments_primary. Tool access is separate from assessment permission. Sensitive-data approval: unknown.
howToObtain: Available to staff across 120+ departments; student access partially enabled via CFG AI-Xplore in Marketplace tab

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Developed in-house by the Enterprise Services Team at NUS IT in collaboration with departments across the University, AI-Know is a university-wide initiative aimed at empowering, enabling, and educating the NUS community on Generative AI (GenAI). Designed as a one-stop super-app for AI-driven tools and training, AI-Know has already impacted nearly 1,000 staff members across more than 120 departments, driving unprecedented levels of digital transformation and innovation.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: At the heart of AI-Know is a centralised suite of AI productivity tools, namely, AI-Chat, AI-Draw, AI-Minute, and AI-Guide These tools are revolutionising traditional workflows by automating manual tasks, enhancing decision-making, and boosting efficiency across administrative and academic domains.

description: Audience: current_nus_students. Tool access is separate from assessment permission. Sensitive-data approval: unknown.
howToObtain: Sign in to ai-know.nus.edu.sg with NUS credentials, navigate to AI-Create in left sidebar, access Marketplace tab, click CFG AI-Xplore

evidence.evidenceSnippet: CFG AI-Xplore is a virtual career assistant chatbot built on the AI-Know suite designed for NUS students.
All NUS students can use CFG AI-Xplore to access career information and NUS-supported resources.

Unfortunately, alumni cannot access CFG AI-Xplore — the chatbot is only available to current NUS students; please contact the NUS Centre for Future-ready Graduates at careers@nus.edu.sg if you have further questions.

description: Audience: students_and_researchers. Announced service; active deployment is unverified. Tool access is separate from assessment permission. Sensitive-data approval: unknown.
howToObtain: Web-based literature discovery platform powered by OpenAI LLM indexing ScholarBank and Digital Gems collections; announced in official news release to be officially launched on 20 August 2026 (active deployment page unverified)

evidence.evidenceSnippet: In a first for Southeast Asia, NUS Libraries and NUS IT have jointly developed AI Sense Maker, a proprietary web-based conversational AI platform powered by OpenAI’s LLM. To be officially launched on 20 August 2026, AI Sense Maker draws on over 150,000 digitised materials from NUS Libraries’ ScholarBank and Digital Gems collections.
